notes.title: Version: 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]- Error correction：[/b]
1. Fixed different player's equipment cause the different mastery reset cooldown time.
2. Fixed the problem that the timer could not display the cooling progress normally when the mastery reset was in the cooling state after load a game.
3. Fixed the possibility of Repeat implementation the employees's characteristics effect. (according to the game mechanism, when there are multiple complainers, the negative effect can be superimposed, which is a normal phenomenon)

[b]- UI tuning:[/b]
Added the description function when hovering over the icon.

notes.title: Version: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]- Error correction:[/b]
Fixed the real estate development company's listing project unable to assign salesmen and rent / sell conversion abnormal and other errors.

[b]- UI tuning:[/b]
Adjust the timing of novice guidance tips to avoid unnecessary appearance.

notes.title: Version: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]- Error correction:[/b]
1.Fixed part of text description.
2.Fixed abnormal background music volume when repeatedly entering the main interface of the game.
3. Revised the text description which is easy to produce ambiguity.

[b]- Content update:[/b]
1.A conditional trigger mechanism is added to make it easier for novices to understand the game for a longer time.
2.The description of the [LOCATION] in the [PROPERTY] section of the [MANUAL] is supplemented.

[b]- Control update:[/b]
Most interfaces add the function of closing by right clicking, and the closing sequence starts from the last opened interface.

[b]- UI tuning:[/b]
Fixed the phenomenon of some UI text wrapping without reason.
